mechanics.scope: Three dynamic convex cubes, fixed separated routes/catchers and two explicitly prescribed visible latches with causal trigger evidence.
mechanics.contact_model: Proposed convex rigid-body contact; actual contact, gap and replay evidence remain required.
mechanics.material_model: Per-actor coefficients are declared in the companion Markdown card; no coefficient is calibrated or measured here.
mechanics.actuation_model: Gravity and contact determine free body motion; only declared visible latches may be prescribed.
limitations: Historical Native Bullet transfer/convergence calibration failed; this plan neither repairs nor relaxes it.
Current analytic backend cannot validate this dynamic-body scope.

route_stages.entry_intent: Cube-a is released while B remains visibly retained.
route_stages.exit_intent: A reaches own catch and latch-1 release sequence completes.
route_stages.mechanism: Gravity/contact plus prescribed latch only after A contact.

route_stages.entry_intent: Released B traverses its separate middle route while A is supported.
route_stages.exit_intent: B approaches its trigger after wall rebound and near pass.

route_stages.entry_intent: B trigger precedes latch-2 motion; C stays retained until release.
route_stages.exit_intent: One delayed B/C transfer leads both toward catches.
route_stages.mechanism: Gravity/contact plus prescribed latch after B trigger.

route_stages.entry_intent: Each cube reaches a distinct receiving support.
route_stages.exit_intent: All three remain visible and supported separately.

events.physical_cause: Cube-a's earned bounce reaches latch-1 lever and mechanically releases cube-b after a planned pause.
events.measurement_required: Measure both A bounce and latch contact as distinct raw episodes, then release continuity; reject early latch travel.

events.physical_cause: After wall rebound, cube-b passes cube-a on separated lanes.
events.measurement_required: Certify approach, positive 0.10–0.18 m surface gap, separation and no contact for the pair.

events.physical_cause: Cube-b's trigger opens latch-2; released cube-c makes one delayed momentum-transfer contact with cube-b.
events.measurement_required: Measure fresh contact onset and pre/post velocities; reject latch motion before its B trigger or a third-body pile-up.

camera.framing_intent: Static wide shot keeps causal latches, the near pass and all separate catches visible.

ending.description: All three cubes have separate supported, non-overlapping final states.

reference_lessons.lesson: Use spatially separated supports and explicit collision geometry; no reference-media claim is made.
